source.paper: Lee, Yan, Brus, Heinz, Hone, Ryu 2010, ACS Nano 4, 2695, doi:10.1021/nn1003937, arXiv:1005.2509
source.figure: Fig. 4b (E2g and A1g positions vs thickness, 532 nm, supported, blue triangles), Fig. 3b (linewidths), Fig. 3a (integrated E2g/A1g ratio)

notes: Synthetic from published relation; flatters the tools arm (the tools encode the same relation). Positions read by the curator from Lee 2010 Fig. 4b to about +-0.3 cm-1, then jittered by 0.2 cm-1: E2g 383.8, A1g 403.4, difference 19.6 cm-1. Widths (FWHM) E2g 2.0, A1g 3.9 cm-1 from Fig. 3b (measured at 514.5 nm with 2.7 cm-1 resolution). Integrated E2g/A1g ratio 0.87 from Fig. 3a. Neighbouring layer numbers differ by only 1 to 2.5 cm-1 in the mode spacing, so this case needs sub-cm-1 fitting. Noise: E2g height / sigma = 40.
